description: Complete API layer: party creation, menu management (CRUD + availability toggle), location/QR management, request submission with validation, request status transitions, fridge scan endpoint, and SSE streaming endpoints. Every route has try/catch with error messages in response body. Graceful degradation for AI scan.
steps: Create src/app/api/parties/route.ts - POST to create a party. Accepts optional name (defaults to 'My Party'). Generates guestCode and hostCode using codes.ts. Sets expiresAt to createdAt + 24h. Creates default supply menu items (toilet paper, sunscreen, bug spray, ice, cups, napkins, paper towels). Returns party data including both codes. Wrap in try/catch, return {error: string} on failure with appropriate HTTP status.

Create src/app/api/parties/[hostCode]/route.ts - GET to fetch party details by hostCode (host authentication). Returns party with menu items, locations, and requests. 404 if not found or expired. try/catch wrapper.
Create src/app/api/parties/[hostCode]/menu/route.ts - GET all menu items, POST to add a drink (name required, category=DRINK). Validates name is non-empty. try/catch wrapper.

Create src/app/api/parties/[hostCode]/menu/[itemId]/route.ts - PATCH to update item (rename, toggle availability), DELETE to remove. After mutation, publish 'menu-update' SSE event to all connected guests. try/catch wrapper.

Create src/app/api/parties/[hostCode]/locations/route.ts - GET all locations, POST to create a location (name required). Generates a unique location code. Returns the location with its guest link. try/catch wrapper.
Create src/app/api/parties/[hostCode]/requests/route.ts - GET all requests for the party, ordered newest first. try/catch wrapper.

Create src/app/api/parties/[hostCode]/requests/[requestId]/route.ts - PATCH to update request status. Validate status transitions: only new->seen, new->done, seen->done are allowed. Reject any other transition with clear error message. After update, publish 'request-update' SSE event. try/catch wrapper.

Create src/app/api/parties/[hostCode]/scan/route.ts - POST accepting multipart form data with 1-5 image files. If OPENAI_API_KEY is not configured, return {error: 'Photo scanning is not configured. Please add drinks manually.', fallback: true}. Send images to OpenAI Vision API (GPT-4o-mini) with a prompt asking to identify drink names from fridge/cooler photos. Parse response into array of drink name strings. If API fails or returns nothing recognizable, return {error: 'Could not identify drinks from the photos. Please add drinks manually.', fallback: true}. On success return {drinks: string[]}. Never auto-publish. Delete/discard image data immediately after API call. try/catch with graceful degradation.

Create src/app/api/party/[guestCode]/route.ts - GET party info for guests. Returns party name, available menu items only (drinks where available=true, all supplies), and location info if locationCode query param provided. 404 if party not found or expired. try/catch wrapper.

Create src/app/api/party/[guestCode]/requests/route.ts - POST to submit a request. Validate: category required (DRINK/SUPPLY/SONG/OTHER), item required for DRINK/SUPPLY (must be on menu and available for DRINK), for DRINK: deliveryType required (LOCATION or NAME), deliveryValue required. LOCATION delivery only allowed if locationCode provided. Reject invalid with specific error messages. On success, publish 'new-request' SSE event to host. Return the created request with status=NEW. try/catch wrapper.
Create src/app/api/party/[guestCode]/requests/[requestId]/route.ts - GET single request status for guest live tracker. Returns request with current status. try/catch wrapper.

Create src/app/api/party/[guestCode]/events/route.ts - SSE endpoint for guests. Streams 'menu-update' and 'request-update' events for the party. Uses ReadableStream with SSE format. Handles client disconnect cleanup.
Create src/app/api/parties/[hostCode]/events/route.ts - SSE endpoint for host. Streams 'new-request' and 'request-update' events. Uses ReadableStream. Handles disconnect cleanup.

Create src/lib/ai.ts - OpenAI Vision integration helper. Function scanFridgePhotos(images: Buffer[]): Promise<{drinks: string[]} | {error: string}>. Handles missing API key, API errors, empty results. Uses fetch to call OpenAI API directly (no SDK dependency needed, keeps bundle smaller).
Create src/lib/validation.ts - shared validation helpers: validateRequestCategory, validateStatusTransition, validateDeliveryTarget. Return {valid: boolean, error?: string}.
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/parties creates a party with default supplies and returns guest/host codes
Menu CRUD operations work and publish SSE events on mutation
Availability toggle on menu items publishes SSE event
Request submission validates all required fields and rejects invalid input with specific error messages
Status transitions enforce new->seen->done forward-only rule
Scan endpoint returns graceful error when OPENAI_API_KEY is missing
All API routes have try/catch and return {error: string} on failure
SSE endpoints establish connections and stream events
Guest API only returns available menu items
verification: Run npm run build to verify all API routes compile without errors
Run npm test to verify any unit tests pass
